character_tex: Branching functions $\chi^{SU(2)_k}_l(\tau,z)\,\Theta_{s,2}(\tau,z) = \sum_{m\in\mathbb{Z}_{2(k+2)}} \chi^l_{m,s}(\tau)\,\Theta_{m,k+2}(\tau,z)$, $\Theta_{m,K}(\tau,z) = \sum_{n\in\mathbb{Z}+m/2K} q^{Kn^2}z^{Kn}$ (Sugawara, arXiv:2004.05742, eq. (A.16) at zero $U(1)$ fugacity), computed from the Weyl-Kac character $\chi_l$ as $\chi^l_{m,s} = q^{-u^2/(k+2)}\,[z^u]\big(\chi_l\,\Theta_{s,2}\big)$ for any $u \in \frac m2 + (k+2)\mathbb{Z}$. Labels: $l+m+s$ even, $(l,m,s)\sim(k-l,\,m+k+2,\,s+2)$; each orbit is labelled by its representative with $s\in\{0,1\}$ ($s=0$ NS, $s=1$ R) and $-(k+2)<m\le k+2$. For $|m-s|\le l$ the weight is $h = \frac{l(l+2)-m^2}{4(k+2)} + \frac{s}{8}$. The NS and R characters of the $\mathcal{N}=2$ algebra are $\chi^l_{m,0}+\chi^l_{m,2}$ and $\chi^l_{m,1}+\chi^l_{m,3}$.
description: Bosonic diagonal coset theory at $k=1$: one term $|\chi^l_{m,s}|^2$ for each of the 12 field-identification orbits, so the NS$\otimes$NS and R$\otimes$R sectors appear with $s_L = s_R$ and there is no NS$\otimes$R sector. The supercurrents $G^\pm$ appear only paired with antiholomorphic fermionic states; the lowest are the four states $G^a\bar G^b$ at $(h,\bar h) = (\frac32,\frac32)$, in the block of the orbit of $(0,0,2)$, labelled $\chi^{1}_{3,0}$. This is the diagonal invariant $Z = \sum_{(a,c)\in Q_k}|\chi_{a,c}|^2$ of Cordova-Rizi (arXiv:2312.17308, eq. (2.31)) and Gray (arXiv:0812.1318, eq. (4) with $M$ the identity), the bosonization of the fermionic $\mathcal{N}=2$ minimal model (Chen-Duan-Jia-Lee, arXiv:2511.22129, supplement A). At $k=1$ the partition function equals that of the compact boson at $R = 2\sqrt3$ (equivalently $R = 1/\sqrt3$) in the convention of the compact-boson entry; Gray writes it as $Z_{R=\sqrt6}$ with self-dual radius 1.
